name: zinput_poll_active_devices
description: zInput::PollActiveDevices dispatches mouse, joystick, and keyboard polling only when the corresponding active flags and poll reference counts are enabled.
known_limits: VC5SP3 COFF target zinput_poll_active_devices covers the dispatcher function and its active-device flag/refcount globals; after recovering the byte dispatch flag ABI, zInput::PollActiveDevices has zero unmasked function-byte mismatches after relocation masking.
